page: Microsoft Azure ND96isr_MI300X_v5 is an isolated, RDMA-capable virtual machine belonging to the NDISv5MI300X family. It is powered by an Intel processor with an x86_64 architecture, providing 96 dedicated vCPUs. The system features 1850.0 GB of system memory, which equates to 19.27 GB of RAM per core.

This server is equipped with eight integrated GPUs and features 31,769 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It is premium storage capable and utilizes the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The network configuration supports RDMA capabilities, though it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high density of GPU accelerators, massive local NVMe storage, and substantial memory capacity, this instance is designed for intensive workloads. It is suited for large-scale AI training, deep learning, high-performance computing, and massive database operations. The hardware profile represents a high-density resource allocation, prioritizing raw computational and storage capacity over low-cost general-purpose configurations.
